{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I hope you get them all. No wonder the Seps managed to land here. The Jedi were traitors all along. You're doing a wonderful job, trooper.|A Biravian female|<ref name="Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
The '''Biravians''' were a group indigenous to the [[Biravia system/Legends|Biravia system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{JCFCite|url=posts/27848315|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2007-12-11|time=7:59 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170916153037/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-43|quote=I wouldn't get your hopes up re alien homeworlds, beyond simple stuff like the Planetnamian species getting a Planetnamia on the map or things Dan and I can account for with a relatively quick reference.|archivefile=File:JasonFry-JCFAtlasHomeworlds.png}} [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', stated his intention in this thread to create homeworlds for numerous species based on context implied from their names. Biravia appears to be one such case.</ref> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a [[Unidentified Biravian|Biravian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] expressed her disdain for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] when she was stopped by a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] at a checkpoint in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]].<ref name="RC 20">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', Chapter 20.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A Biravian character appears in ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published by [[Del Rey]] in [[2008]]. The novel fails to indicate whether ''Biravian'' refers to a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] or some other social group.<ref name="RC 20" />
